Acme's net balance of 31766 matches my own check: orders 140 and 143 total 45425, less the 13659 refund on order 140. Next I'll get birch's net balance.
Birch's net balance of 35795 matches my check: orders 141 and 144 total 55259, less the 19464 refund on order 144. Cobalt is the last customer, so I'll get its net balance next.
Cobalt's net balance of 20917 matches my check: orders 142 and 145 total 20917 with no refunds. All three balances are verified, so I'll record the first payout, for acme.
Acme's payout of 31766 recorded successfully. Next I'll record birch's payout of 35795, which I already verified against the orders and refunds.
Acme and birch are paid. Cobalt's net balance of 20917 was already verified against its orders and the refund table, so I'll record that last payout.
All three payouts were recorded successfully after the refunds table matched Alpha's report and each net balance matched my own check. The batch is complete.
